What we offer

Services you can engage us for, grouped by the objective you are working towards.

  • Find the right opportunities

    Understand demand, assess where your strengths fit and identify suitable partners. Decide what merits further attention.

  • Enter and grow in Japan or India

    Develop a route to customers, adapt your offer, establish channels and grow your market presence.

  • Turn interest into commitments

    Develop workable agreements, qualify suppliers and prepare opportunities for financing with qualified specialists.

  • Set up and improve operations

    Choose operating arrangements, strengthen existing collaborations and prepare people and organizations to deliver.

  • Create new business and sustain value

    Develop joint offers, pursue third-market opportunities, and support succession or renewal.

  • Coordinate complex initiatives

    Align several organizations, clarify responsibilities and coordinate their contributions to a shared undertaking.

You can start with one focused piece of work. Getting started

View all sixteen services and their offerings

For an overview of the four kinds of work behind these services, see What we do

Each assignment includes the offerings agreed with you. Recommendations support your decisions; customers, partners and financiers make their own decisions.
